chunks: He replied (peace be upon him): Just as He provides them livelihood although they do not see Him.

key_terms.وَلَا يَرَوْنَهُ: and they do not see Him

ai.seo_question: How does God provide for creation if He is unseen?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (AS) underscores the paradox of Divine Sustenance (Rizq), where God provides for creation despite being invisible to the eye. This reflects the Shia theological emphasis on God's transcendence (Tanzih) and the reliance on faith rather than sensory perception to recognize His continuous care. The statement serves as a reminder that true sustenance is not merely material but also spiritual, rooted in the unseen reality of God's presence.
